name: War of Eleven
description: The war between eleven feuding principalities after which Ghirapur was founded as neutral ground.

timeline.summary: The War of Eleven ends when the nobles' court inventors open communication and end the conflict, founding Ghirapur and the first Consulate.
timeline.quote: The eleven artificers made the contested land their nation

timeline.summary: Ghirapur is founded as neutral ground between eleven feuding principalities after the War of Eleven and grows to dominate its region.
timeline.quote: Ghirapur was founded in the aftermath of the War of Eleven as a neutral ground between eleven feuding principalities.
